sql.processStepStatus.getTypesForCompany: select * from flow.company_process_step_status_type where archived is not true and case when :isParent then company_id = :parentCompanyId else company_id = :companyId end order by process_step_status_type
sql.processStepStatus.getActiveTypeForCompan: select * from flow.company_process_step_status_type where archived is not true and company_id = :companyId and process_step_status_type_id = 1
sql.processStepStatus.getType: select id, process_step_status_type, process_step_status_type_id, archived from flow.company_process_step_status_type st where id = :typeId
sql.processStepStatus.deleteType: update flow.company_process_step_status_type set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepStatus.updateType: update flow.company_process_step_status_type set process_step_status_type = :statusType, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
